name: Learning Sessions
summary: Focused sessions where students explore one technology topic together, from the basics to practical examples.
gains: A guided start on a topic before you study it alone
Answers to the questions you would otherwise search for hours
Notes and resources to keep learning afterwards

name: Workshops
summary: Hands-on workshops where you follow along on your own laptop and leave with something that works.
gains: Practical skills you can use the same day
Experience with real tools, not just slides
A small finished piece of work

name: Meetups
summary: Relaxed meetups to meet other students in Nepalgunj who care about technology.
gains: Friends who share your interests
Study partners and teammates
A sense of what others are learning

name: Project Building
summary: Small teams turning ideas into websites, apps, tools and experiments.
gains: Portfolio work you can show
Teamwork and Git experience
The confidence of shipping something real

name: Peer Learning
summary: Students helping students: study circles, doubt sessions and friendly code reviews.
gains: Faster progress when you are stuck
Deeper understanding by explaining to others
Accountability to keep going

name: Networking
summary: Connections with seniors, alumni and people already working in technology.
gains: People who can guide your next step
A clearer picture of the tech field
Introductions you would not get alone

name: Career Opportunities
summary: Verified internships, jobs, scholarships and programmes collected in one place.
gains: Opportunities you might otherwise miss
Clear eligibility and deadlines
Encouragement to actually apply

name: Competitions
summary: Hackathons, coding contests and challenges, with help finding a team.
gains: Skills tested under real pressure
Teammates and new friends
Experience worth putting on a CV

name: Community Discussions
summary: Open conversations about tools, trends, careers and the questions students actually have.
gains: Different perspectives on the same problem
Practice explaining your ideas
Awareness of what is changing in tech

name: Mentorship
summary: Guidance on learning paths, projects and careers from people a few steps ahead.
gains: A learning plan that fits you
Honest feedback on your work
Someone to ask when you are unsure

name: Volunteering
summary: Help run NISC: events, content, design, outreach and tech.
gains: Leadership and event experience
Skills beyond coding
A bigger role in the community

name: Student Collaboration
summary: Working across colleges, faculties and skills: developers, designers and future founders together.
gains: Teams with complementary skills
Friends beyond your own college
Ideas that grow bigger together
